question_nl: Which suppliers (s_name) belong to the region with r_name EUROPE and have a balance lower than 0?
question_sql: SELECT  s.s_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE' AND s.s_acctbal < 0;
